recipes.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: dedicated 2D beat-em-up boss reaction sprite atlas. Input image: identity, armor and painterly style reference ONLY. Draw NEW anatomically articulated reaction poses, never rotate or copy a standing pose. Transparent background. Exactly SIX separate full-body figures in a regular THREE columns by TWO rows wide landscape sheet, with generous transparent gutters; no contact between figures or their spears. Row-major order: 1 standing hurt recoil, chest pulled backward, painful face, feet grounded; 2 stronger hurt doubled forward clutching torso, knee bent, feet grounded; 3 collapsing onto one knee, shoulders sagging; 4 falling sideways, torso near horizontal, one elbow meeting ground; 5 fully defeated, lying completely flat on side, entire head torso hips and legs supported on one ground line, closed eyes, no lifted hips; 6 recovering, one knee and one palm planted, pushing torso up. Right-facing identity in all poses; for prone poses HEAD on the RIGHT, FEET on LEFT to agree with right-facing standing. Identical anatomical size, head size and armor details across all SIX poses. Spears are visibly complete, held or touching each character, never detached loose objects. Spear shafts MUST retain same full length as reference, roughly 1.5 times standing helmet-to-foot height; show BOTH butt and sharp point, even in prone poses. In low poses use diagonal/horizontal spear with full length within its own cell. Full-body uncropped. Crisp high-resolution painterly game art matching reference. No ground shadow, particles, blood, arrows, text, labels, borders, watermark or background. Wide canvas with enough space for long spears.
Preserve blue clothing, black lamellar armor with brass trim, white sash and wraps, black helmet with swept black plume, narrow symmetrical cross-shaped jumonji spear head.
recipes.source_policy: original generated alpha and pixels retained; native runtime registration only
